description: Election Commission - Declare that Mrs. U Pragash, She has Ceased to be a member of the United People's Freedom Alliance to the Colombo Municipal council
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of the Colombo Municipal Council due to ceasing membership in a political party. The notice is issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance by the Returning Officer. This content directly relates to the electoral process and the status of an elected official, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
